uploads.name: Arnavaz
uploads.description: Daughter of Jamshid. Ivory mask carved with gold floral tracery and a dark streak down the right cheek, long straight black hair with blunt fringe, long cream tassel earrings. Slate-blue wool vest embroidered with gold flowers, silver belt, full cream linen blouse and wide gathered trousers, silver cuffs and embossed silver boots.

uploads.name: Shahrnaz
uploads.description: Daughter of Jamshid. Ivory mask covered in fine gold floral tracery, long straight centre-parted black hair, disc-and-tassel earrings. Quilted cream bib embroidered with dark red rosettes, black puffed sleeves, long layered charcoal tweed skirt, bronze arm cuffs, medallion belt, black boots.

uploads.name: Musician
uploads.description: Court musician. Tall black velvet hat worn low over the eyes, embroidered with a silver cross motif, long black hair, drop earrings. Long dark brown linen robe with embroidered collar and cuffs, tasselled woven sash, embroidered slippers. Plays a pear-shaped lute, standing or seated on a carved stool.

uploads.name: Cat Persian Longhair
uploads.description: Long-haired Persian cat, ginger and cream with a white ruff, chest and paws, heavy plumed tail, half-lidded amber eyes. Photographed lying on a carpet-covered bench against a pale plaster wall.

uploads.name: Instrument Saz
uploads.description: Long-necked pear-shaped lute, about 120 cm. Pale spruce soundboard, ribbed dark rosewood back with light inlay lines, tied gut frets, carved animal-head pegbox with four dark wooden pegs, four strings, tied bridge, black wooden stand. Also seen in the daughters chamber (LOC-020).

uploads.name: Dagger Horse Head
uploads.description: Ornate straight dagger, about 28 cm. Bronze horse-head pommel with red gem eyes, black cord-wrapped grip between jewelled bronze collars, gem-set crossguard, tapering double-edged blade with pierced bronze filigree and inset red stones down the centre. Worn at the sash with a dark red embroidered robe.

uploads.name: Armayel
uploads.description: Masked man in a black wool cap and cropped black jacket with four cross-shaped copper fasteners, wide black skirt-trousers and black shoes. Teal ceramic mask painted with cream and coral blossom branches; grey curls at the nape. Episode 15 figure.

uploads.name: Garmayel
uploads.description: Masked man with a dark wound turban and a pale cracked-clay mask with a long ridged nose and slit eyes. Red and black woven tribal vest over a black tunic and a long brown patterned skirt-robe, black shoes. Grey hair at the nape. Episode 15 figure, sibling of Armayel.

uploads.name: Big Brother
uploads.description: Young man with black curly hair, a beaded headband and a turquoise cracked-plaster mask embroidered with pearl flowers and borders. Loose patterned grey-brown tunic and balloon trousers, cream ankle boots. The elder of the two brothers in episode 15.

uploads.name: Little Brother
uploads.description: Child with dark curly hair and a round felted-wool face mask with button eyes, a stitched red smile and a small nose. Navy wool jacket with floral trim at collar, pockets and cuffs, grey corduroy trousers, cream sneakers. The younger brother; the adult look is V02.

uploads.originalName: بزرگیهای بردادر کوچکتر برای صحنه آخر.png

uploads.name: Head Chef
uploads.description: Man with black curly hair and a cream headband tie, wearing a red studded leather mask with metal beads and a floral stud pattern. Blue linen shirt, long cream apron with pockets, loose cream trousers and brown sandals. Episode 15 head chef of the Zahhak kitchen.

uploads.name: Zahhak Kitchen Main
uploads.description: Large white-tiled industrial kitchen in cold blue light from a ceiling skylight panel. Long central wooden prep table, steel cauldrons and stoves down both sides, extraction hoods, steam, four masked cooks in dark smocks working in silhouette. Wet dark floor.

uploads.name: Slaughter Prep Room
uploads.description: Cold green-grey stone and marble hall with a central rough-cut stone slab table, steel hooks on overhead rails with hanging carcasses, marble counter on the left, carved pillars at both edges and ceiling light strips.

uploads.name: Back Courtyard Transfer
uploads.description: Back transfer courtyard of the Zahhak palace at night: a deep stone ruin court with arched bays holding cauldrons and small fires, upper arcades and crenellated galleries, in blue fog. Colonnade, barred window and balustrade views are further looks of it.

uploads.name: Back Exit To Plain
uploads.description: Outside corner of a colossal dark stone palace wall in blue fog, a tiny low doorway at its foot and a faint amber window high up, rubble and a low stone line leading out onto an open dark plain.

uploads.originalName: دشت و دامنه کوه در سپیده دم.png
uploads.name: Dawn Plain Mountain Foot
uploads.description: Wide misty grassland plain at dawn under heavy violet-grey cloud, low dark mountain ridges on the horizon with one pale gap of light, dry grass and scattered dark stones in the foreground.

uploads.name: Narrow Escape Passage
uploads.description: Near-black rock-cut passage with thick rough pillars and stepped stone bases either side, a faint light far down the narrowing corridor, bare earth floor.

uploads.name: Vessel Snake Feeding Tray
uploads.description: Long shallow dark-metal oval tray, about 2 m across, with a swan-necked handle at each end shaped as a scaled serpent with its head curled outward. Engraved band of plants and creatures along the inner rim, two shallow wells and a central pedestal with iron spokes. Shown on a black granite plinth.

uploads.originalName: بزرگیهای بردادر کوچکتر برای صحنه آخر.png

uploads.name: Townsfolk Masked
uploads.description: Background townsfolk and minor characters of episode 15, shown one person per look. Each wears a different soft handmade mask (knitted, beaded, felted, wool, carved wood or metal plate) with a plain face, over loose layered everyday clothes in muted wool and linen. No weapons or insignia. Use for crowds, extras and passers-by, never for named characters.

uploads.name: Cloak Burlap Grey
uploads.description: Escape disguise: one large coarse grey burlap cloth draped over the head and body so that no face or hair shows, pinned at the chest with a small peg and a thin cord. Worn over a dusty grey linen tunic and dark skirt. Worn threadbare with a faint faded leaf pattern along the hem.

uploads.name: Cleaver Butcher Wide
uploads.description: Oversized butcher cleaver: one very wide, long rectangular blade of dull scratched grey steel, slightly curved along the cutting edge, plain and unadorned, with a short dark round wooden handle set at the top right corner. Shown flat on a dark green-black surface.

uploads.name: Zahhak Kitchen Black Tile
uploads.description: Vast black-tiled palace kitchen with relief carvings of beasts across the walls, three tall arched niches, stone lion-head plaques, and three white globe lamps hanging from the ceiling. Dark iron ranges with copper-ringed knobs and copper pots in the centre, long prep counters with food to the left, a steel sink run to the right, shelves of copper pans, and a drainage grate across the stone floor.

uploads.name: Fugitive Camp Gorge
uploads.description: A hidden camp of the fugitives in a narrow fog-filled gorge between two sheer dark cliffs. Rock-cut dwellings and stone arches climb the right slope, cloth awnings and small campfires are scattered across the terraced floor, a bridge crosses far back, and bare trees stand in the foreground. Blue dusk haze.

uploads.name: Rescued Survivors
uploads.description: The people rescued from the palace, shown as a row standing on grassland under grey sky. Every face is hidden: veils and head cloths in green, maroon, olive, black, white and rust, over embroidered and beaded masks. Long loose robes in faded green, blue, cream, olive and brown. Each look is a different line-up; use for crowd shots of the freed.

uploads.originalName: Namaye az doore shahr va ghaleye zahhak.png
uploads.name: Zahhak Citadel Distant View
uploads.description: Distant elevated view from a cracked rocky ridge across a foggy plain: a grid-planned city with canals and low roofs, and Zahhak's black fortress rising on a rock massif on the right horizon. Blue pre-dawn haze, dark rock in the foreground corners.

uploads.originalName: Zoroofe ashpazkhane Garmayel maghzaha ro dorost mikone.png
uploads.name: Vessel Set Brain Prep
uploads.description: Table still life of Garmayel's cooking vessels: a large dark metal wok-like pan holding pale brains, dried herbs and red sauce with a ladle, around it engraved copper and dark metal jugs, footed bowls with etched animal figures, bowls of brains and herbs, a flat spatula with a wooden handle, and a few spoons. Dark grey surface.

uploads.name: Zahhak Prison
uploads.description: Zahhak prison: a vast underground cavern of rough grey-green rock walls lost in mist, a flat dusty stone floor, and at its centre a stark stepped monolithic black block with a single tall dark doorway. Small dark cell doors are cut into the cavern walls in a row on both sides. Cold dim haze from above, grainy, oppressive and silent.
